A machine learning model trained on binary alloy data can be transferred to predict properties of multi-element HEAs.
Conventional empirical models (rule-of-mixtures) exhibit prediction deviations greater than 10% for thermal conductivity in HEAs.
Increased lattice distortion and disorder lower phonon mean free path and thus thermal conductivity.
